_comment: README: mutate covers production TS only (tests excluded; viewer has no bun test command yet). Scope a run to changed files with: bunx stryker run --mutate <changed production files>. Command runner (the default testRunner) reuses the existing bun test command. inPlace is required: tests spawn venv/bin/python via repo-relative paths, so a sandbox copy would lack venv. KNOWN ISSUE: checkers/typescript crashes at init with typescript@7 native (ts.sys undefined in the version-stub entry); default checkers is [] so `bunx stryker run` works; add --checkers typescript only once the checker supports TS7.
